text: {"lessons":["My account has grown so far, but a few months of gains do not prove that my trades are outperforming the market; I should judge results over a longer period.","I added to Stock C at a much higher price, so I should require a clear reason to increase a position rather than chase recent price moves.","I sold Stock B at a loss and Stock D at a gain; I should set and follow a risk plan for each holding instead of letting my average cost or emotions dictate when to sell."]}
